problems.problem: Visible change from the last version: the lighter floor deck and its full-width wall/floor junction (previously at y≈1230) are gone, and the contact-detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] confirms the base now sits on one continuous mineral plane with no deck edge inside the crop. However the 'no seams, no joints' monolith is not fully delivered: a faint horizontal panel joint still crosses the wall at y≈715-725 behind the bottle shoulder (visible left of x≈339 and right of x≈741), with two faint vertical joints descending from it near x≈190 and x≈915. These read as cast-concrete formwork panel lines, contradicting the declared seamless void and slightly domesticating the monument.

Contact detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] re-confirms a genuine contact shadow at offset_y 0 (correct, do not move): a dark occlusion core sits flush under the base. It is still narrower than the 402 px footprint - it pinches out roughly 30-40 px short of each base corner - and the plane immediately in front of the base stays uniformly light with no faint forward penumbra, so under the declared broad soft frontal light the monument rests lightly at its corners despite the correct offset.

References 3-5 all let the environment react to the hero (Diptyque's ceiling glow refracted in the glass, Hermès's dust wrapping the silhouette, Prada's matched studio wrap). Here the radial glow behind the hero exists, but the wall shows no local luminance reaction adjacent to the dark silhouette (no subtle bounce or darkening halo), and the glass edges keep warm specular streaks that ignore the cool #9aa0a4 ambient, so the bottle retains a slight clean-cutout read against the plane; this remains the largest gap to campaign-grade integration.

Hierarchy and alignment remain disciplined (logo 26 / title 72 / subtitle 24 in one tight left block, text_product_overlap all false, no collision with the bottle at x≥339), but the accent rule under the subtitle still renders as a near-black hairline and the declared palette accent #b0762a appears nowhere in the typographic block; the promised cool-grey / ink / copper monument grid executes as two colors, leaving the type block visually disconnected from the warm gold label it should echo.

changes.value: Monolithic flat raw cast concrete wall in cool grey, perfectly continuous matte mineral surface extending edge to edge with no seams, no joints, no panel lines, no formwork marks, no corner, no horizon and no floor deck, very subtle broad radial luminance falloff softly brighter behind the center of the plane and faintly cooling toward the edges, even diffuse frontal illumination with cool diffuse ambient wrap that gently grazes any standing object and leaves a faint soft luminance reaction in the air beside any dark silhouette, empty architectural void
